title: AI Image Combiner
summary: Free AI image combiner: merge two or more photos into one picture in Flick, a person into a new place, a product into a scene or two characters together.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI image combiner?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every combined picture on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I combine two pictures into one with AI?


Add both pictures as reference images, then write one prompt that names what to take from each, such as the person from Image 1 and the room from Image 2, and how they meet, such as where the person stands and where the light comes from.


### How many images can I combine at once?


It depends on the model: GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, Seedream 5.5 up to 10 and Nano Banana 2.1 up to 9, enough for a few people, a place and a prop in one picture.


### Can I put myself into another photo with AI?


Yes. Add a clear photo of yourself and a photo of the place, then ask for the same face, hair and clothes in that place, with the place's own light falling on you.


### Can AI combine a product photo with a new background?


Yes. Add the product shot and the scene, ask for the product exactly as it is at a believable size, and describe a shadow or reflection where it touches the surface so it sits in the scene.


### Will the combined image keep the same faces?


Usually, when the prompt names the features to keep, such as hair colour, glasses or a beard; generate a few versions side by side on one canvas and keep the one where every face matches.


### Can I turn a combined image into a video?


Yes. Use the combined picture as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as a laugh or the wind in their hair.
